edits.old: And no other service starts JOB-17
edits.new:
And no other service starts JOB-17

  Scenario: AC13 The rule, the archive location and the run are owned and read as data (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given retention rule version "RET-2026.11" holds product "DP10", table "document", the archive container "rwb-docs-archive", a batch size, and a purge setting
    When JOB-17 runs
    Then the container, the batch size, the rule version and the purge setting are read from rows or properties
    And the run reads and writes only "rwb_document" and reaches the other owners only through their contracts
    And JOB-17 is started by the Schedule of rwb-document and calls the P1 archive contract once

  Scenario Outline: AC14 A call that is not authenticated or names a job that does not exist is answered (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given <condition>
    When the caller <call>
    Then the system answers status <status> and no run starts

    Examples:
      | condition | call | status |
      | the caller presents no valid credential | posts a rerun of JOB-17 | 401 |
      | the job id named in the call does not exist | posts a rerun of that job id | 404 |

  Scenario: AC15 A contract call that does not answer within 2 s fails the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the P3 case contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When JOB-17 runs
    Then the run ends "FAILED" and no document is archived or deleted
    And the retry count of the activity is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E1017-APP-AC13)

  Scenario: AC16 A consumed call that fails ends the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the P1 archive contract fails
    When JOB-17 runs
    Then the run ends "FAILED" with MSG-GEN-006 for system "P1 archive contract"
    And no document is deleted before the archive copy is checked
